{{Top|leg}}
A '''braking engine''' was a thruster that slowed the descent of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] dropping from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to the surface of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[drop-sled]]s were equipped with braking engines.
